A small [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] '''garrison''' was located on [[Ataria Island]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Spira/Legends|Spira]]. Personnel stationed at the garrison were mainly there to serve as [[honor guard]]s to the [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]], [[Dark side adept/Legends|Adepts]], [[Governor/Legends|Governors]] and elite VIPs vacationing on the resort world rather than enforce [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] law. As a result, the garrison staff was well-mannered and cordial.
